transcript:
Customer: Hi, I’m calling about an issue with my billing. I noticed an extra charge this month.

Agent: Hello! I’m here to help you with that. Can I have your account email to look into the details?

Customer: Sure, it’s john.smith@email.com.

Agent: Thank you, John. One moment while I pull up your account... Okay, I see the extra charge. It appears to be for our Pro plan, which you upgraded to last month.

Customer: I didn’t mean to upgrade! I wanted to stick with the Basic plan. 

Agent: I understand, and I’m sorry for the confusion. Would you like me to revert your account back to the Basic plan right now?

Customer: Yes, please do that. I really don’t need the extra features.

Agent: No problem at all. I’ll process that change. Just so you know, the Basic plan does offer great essential features if you ever consider it down the line.

Customer: Yeah, I appreciate that. But honestly, I’m a bit frustrated about the mix-up.

Agent: I completely understand, and I'm really sorry for the inconvenience this has caused you. I’ll also make sure to credit that extra charge back to your account.

Customer: That’s good to hear. How long will that take to show up?

Agent: It should reflect in your account within 3-5 business days. You’ll receive an email confirmation once it’s processed.

Customer: Okay, thanks for letting me know. What about my billing cycle? 

Agent: Your billing cycle will remain the same, on the first of each month. 

Customer: Got it. I might think about switching plans again in the future, but I need to review my options.

Agent: Absolutely! Feel free to reach out anytime if you have questions about our plans or need a demo of the Pro features. 

Customer: I will, thanks for your help today.

Agent: You’re welcome, John. Thank you for your understanding. Have a great day! 

Customer: You too!
